scientific_role: physics-conditioned spatial first-passage hazard solver; NOT a source classifier, posterior corrector, reliability gate, or end-to-end localizer

model.family: spatial wind/map encoder + source/query geometric conditioning + discrete hazard decoder
model.hazard_definition: h_j(s,X) = P(F=j | F>=j, s, X) for j in 0..79

loss.kind: discrete event-time hazard log-likelihood (proper scoring on the induced distribution)
loss.numerical_guard: h clipped to [1e-7, 1-1e-7] before log; NaN/Inf is terminal

spatial_patch.orientation: world-aligned, query-centered (source-independent; no rotation to source direction)

channels.name: wind_u
channels.source: causal local wind samples binned onto the patch grid

channels.name: wind_v
channels.source: causal local wind samples binned onto the patch grid

wind_binning.method: nearest-cell assignment of causal route wind samples (pose-matched (x,y)->cell); cells with no sample take the mean of the patch wind; empty patch takes 0
wind_binning.causality: only samples with timestamp <= current stop end (no future samples)

geometric_vector.carrier_half_diagonal: 0.5 * 0.3 * hypot(size_i, size_j) from PMFS quotient carrier

hazard_decoder.no_obstacle_mask_override: the inherited PMFS mask contract is applied only at the source-evidence scoring stage, not inside the network

normalization.spatial_patch: occupancy is already in {0,1}; wind_u/wind_v are divided by a frozen scale of 1.0 m/s (no data-dependent statistics on spatial channels)
normalization.geometric_vector: TRAIN-only columnwise mean and population std; std < 1e-6 replaced by 1.0; NaN/Inf terminal

training.checkpoint_tie_break: earliest epoch attaining the minimum accepted validation hazard loss
training.checkpoint_selection: validation proper hazard loss only (no rank/localization/planner signal)

static_wind.construction: identical architecture/data/seed/order; wind_u and wind_v channels replaced by a constant 0.0 (capacity-matched, no extra parameters)
static_wind.purpose: test whether spatial wind conditioning is physically load-bearing

controls.time_permute: SHA-256-derived permutation from CTT-H01-HAZARD-TIME|wind|transport|source|stop; preserve hit multiset

wind_deployability.W_gen: full CFD field used only by GADEN to generate the plume; never a network input
wind_deployability.W_online: local wind samples at visited poses, binned onto the patch grid; runtime source is a calibrated onboard anemometer
wind_deployability.scope: SIMULATION_KNOWN_WIND (exact simulator wind provenance); no real-flight claim
